title: 完整LFT：不要把对角代理叫作μ上界
cells:
# Complete exact normalized LFT: v=diag(dm,dk) z_delta
w_mu=np.logspace(-3,2,200);matrices=[];d_logs=[];upper=[];diagonal_proxy=[]
for w in w_mu:
    s=1j*w;K=kernel(s);h=1/(s*s+.2*s+1+K);W=weight(s)
    M=np.array([[-.3*s*s*h,-.3*s*s*h,s*s*h*K],[-.3*h,-.3*h,h*K],[.3*W*h,.3*W*h,W*(1-h*K)]])
    def bound(x):
        d=np.exp(np.r_[x,0.]);return np.linalg.svd(d[:,None]*M/d[None,:],compute_uv=False)[0]
    fit=minimize(bound,[0.,0.],method='Nelder-Mead',options={'maxiter':160,'xatol':1e-7,'fatol':1e-9})
    x=fit.x if bound(fit.x)<bound([0.,0.]) else np.zeros(2)
    matrices.append(M);d_logs.append(x);upper.append(bound(x));diagonal_proxy.append(max(abs(np.diag(M))))
matrices=np.array(matrices);upper=np.array(upper);diagonal_proxy=np.array(diagonal_proxy)
lft_error=0.
for dm in [-1.,0.,1.]:
    for dk in [-1.,0.,1.]:
        Delta=np.diag([dm,dk])
        actual=weight(1j*w_mu)*responses(w_mu,1+.3*dm,1+.3*dk)[0]
        closed=np.array([M[2,2]+M[2,:2]@Delta@np.linalg.solve(np.eye(2)-M[:2,:2]@Delta,M[:2,2]) for M in matrices])
        lft_error=max(lft_error,float(np.max(abs(closed-actual))))
assert lft_error<1e-10
j=int(np.argmax(upper))
print('D_upper_grid_peak %.9f at %.9f rad/s; feasible scaling, not exact real mu or all-frequency certificate'%(upper[j],w_mu[j]))
print('diagonal_proxy_grid_peak %.9f; NOT a valid upper bound'%max(diagonal_proxy))
print('LFT_9_parameter_closures_max_error',lft_error)
# Coupling alone can invalidate max(diag): det(I-M Delta)=0 at Delta=I
bad=np.array([[0.,1.],[1.,0.]])
print('zero_diagonal_counterexample proxy=',max(abs(np.diag(bad))),'actual_mu=1, det=',np.linalg.det(np.eye(2)-bad))
plt.figure(figsize=(7,3));plt.semilogx(w_mu,upper,label='Complete feasible-D upper bound');plt.semilogx(w_mu,diagonal_proxy,'--',label='Invalid diagonal proxy');plt.axhline(1,color='black',ls=':');plt.xlabel('Frequency (rad/s)');plt.ylabel('Dimensionless');plt.grid(True);plt.legend();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('lft_complete')

title: 固定滤波PID：标称、500个样本与参数网格
cells:
# Nominal plant and realizable filtered PID, not an executed synthesis result
w=np.logspace(-3,2,1000);W=weight(1j*w)
K_tf=ctrl.tf([Kd*wf+Kp,Kp*wf+Ki,Ki*wf],[1,wf,0])
G0=ctrl.tf([1],[1,.2,1]);S0,T0,U0=responses(w)
nominal=float(max(abs(W*S0)));nominal_j=int(np.argmax(abs(W*S0)))
stack=np.sqrt(abs(W*S0)**2+abs(.01*U0)**2+abs(.2*T0)**2)
# Characteristic quartic: m s^4+(.2+20m)s^3+(k+4+15)s^2+(20k+102)s+40
def characteristic(m,k):return [m,.2+20*m,k+19.,20*k+102.,40.]
corners=[]
for m,k in [(1.,1.),(.7,.7),(.7,1.3),(1.3,.7),(1.3,1.3)]:
    S,T,U=responses(w,m,k);j=int(np.argmax(abs(W*S)));alpha=float(max(np.roots(characteristic(m,k)).real))
    corners.append([m,k,float(abs(W*S)[j]),float(w[j]),alpha])
print('nominal_WpS_grid_peak %.9f at %.9f rad/s'%(nominal,w[nominal_j]))
print('nominal_stack_grid_peak %.9f; high_frequency_stack_limit %.9f'%(max(stack),np.sqrt((1/1.5)**2+(.01*15)**2)))
print('m k WpS_grid_peak frequency spectral_abscissa')
for row in corners:print(' '.join('%.9f'%v for v in row))
print('filtered_K_infinity',Kp+Kd*wf,'S_DC=0; ideal_PID_weighted_KS_Hinf=infinity')
print('nominal_complete')
# Fixed iid uniform distribution, seed 42, no controller tuning on these points
rng=np.random.default_rng(42);dm_samples=rng.uniform(-1,1,500);dk_samples=rng.uniform(-1,1,500)
sample_peaks=[];sample_alpha=[]
for dm,dk in zip(dm_samples,dk_samples):
    m,k=1+.3*dm,1+.3*dk;sample_peaks.append(float(max(abs(W*responses(w,m,k)[0]))));sample_alpha.append(float(max(np.roots(characteristic(m,k)).real)))
sample_peaks=np.array(sample_peaks);worst_index=int(np.argmax(sample_peaks))
print('500_sample_peak_min_mean_max_p95',np.min(sample_peaks),np.mean(sample_peaks),np.max(sample_peaks),np.percentile(sample_peaks,95))
print('500_sample_failures',int(sum(sample_peaks>=1)),'max_pole_real',max(sample_alpha))
print('largest_in_this_sample dm dk',dm_samples[worst_index],dk_samples[worst_index])
print('sampling_complete')
# Preserve three views: nominal/sample, histogram, 20x20 parameter surface
axis=np.linspace(-1,1,20);surface=np.empty((20,20))
for a,dm in enumerate(axis):
    for b,dk in enumerate(axis):surface[a,b]=max(abs(W*responses(w,1+.3*dm,1+.3*dk)[0]))
print('20x20_grid_min_max',surface.min(),surface.max(),'failures',int(sum((surface>=1).ravel())))
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(12,3.4))
worst_curve=abs(W*responses(w,1+.3*dm_samples[worst_index],1+.3*dk_samples[worst_index])[0])
axs[0].semilogx(w,abs(W*S0),label='Nominal');axs[0].semilogx(w,worst_curve,label='Largest in 500 samples');axs[0].axhline(1,color='black',ls=':');axs[0].set_xlabel('Frequency (rad/s)');axs[0].set_ylabel('|Wp S|');axs[0].legend(fontsize=7);axs[0].grid(True)
axs[1].hist(sample_peaks,bins=25);axs[1].axvline(1,color='red',ls=':');axs[1].set_xlabel('Grid peak |Wp S|');axs[1].set_ylabel('Count')
im=axs[2].contourf(axis,axis,surface,levels=16);fig.colorbar(im,ax=axs[2]);axs[2].set_xlabel('dk');axs[2].set_ylabel('dm');axs[2].set_title('20 x 20 parameter grid')
plt.tight_layout();plt.show();print('plots_complete')
